title: First Love v13 intro
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: The opening 31 seconds of a Tamil or Telugu film love theme, the moment the hero sees the girl for the very first time: wonder, curiosity and a happy shock, like time stops and the heart skips. Mysterious in a POSITIVE way, magical and glowing, full of curiosity and surprise; never sad, never dark, never tense, no minor key. Key: G major with the bright raised fourth of raga Kalyani (C sharp) giving a magical, wondering, dreamlike shine; it stays major and bright the whole time. Tempo 92 BPM. Written the South Indian film-music way: the melody is phrased like a playback singer, with gamakam slides, quick grace-note turns and a long held note that bends upward at the end. Every real instrument is close, dry and natural, played by real musicians, no heavy echo on them. 0-4 s: out of a soft, warm glow, a single bansuri flute plays a curious rising question phrase on the raised fourth, then stops, as if holding its breath. 4-8 s: a surprise: a bright plucked veena and a glassy celesta answer with a sparkling, playful turn; a soft tabla tap and a finger-snap begin to tick in time. 8-14 s: a light, curious pizzicato violin pattern and the tabla start a gentle, mysterious-but-smiling groove at 92 BPM; deep warm bass enters; the flute asks its question again, higher. 14-20 s: a shock of joy: a sudden bright string-section stab and a tabla flourish, then the violins sweep up together in Indian-style unison with slides, wide-eyed and amazed. 20-27 s: the curiosity grows: the groove fills out with a soft kick and shaker, flute and violin trade quick smiling phrases, the excitement rises with a climbing string line. 27-29 s: a rising tabla roll and string swell build the anticipation to the peak. 29-31 s: everything stops on a held bright G major chord with the raised fourth, a suspended breath of wonder before the love song begins. Not sad, not dark, not horror, not suspense, not a thriller, not ambient, not slow, no minor key, no EDM, no white-noise risers, no heavy echo.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct: v12 take 2 beautiful after 30 s, before that 'damn sad'; wants mysterious in a positive way with curiosity, surprise and shock. Take 2 is G major 92 BPM and has a near-silent breath at 29.5-31 s, then the full band enters, so this intro is 31 s in G major at 92 BPM and ends on that held breath.

story: New 31 s opening for First Love v12 take 2 (joined to take 2 from 31 s): the first glance as positive mystery, curiosity, surprise and a jolt of wonder, never sad.
